vertical.caption: was calmed by a knight
vertical.edit: Edit of the 6.5 s hug frame, centuries ago: same camera and pose, the living room becomes a stone castle hall with a fireplace and plain banners; a knight in armour (visor up, kind face) kneels where the blue parrot was and hugs the green parrot in exactly the same way; the green parrot's crest has faded from red back to soft green and its eyes are closing. The blue parrot is gone.

vertical.caption: has just calmed a baby
vertical.edit: Edit of the 6.5 s hug frame: same living room, camera and pose, but the blue parrot now holds a sleeping baby in its wings instead of the green parrot; the baby is fast asleep with a dummy in its mouth and one last tear on its cheek; the green parrot is gone.

horizontal.caption: to calm down
horizontal.edit: Edit of the 6.5 s hug frame: the blue parrot has stepped back and only watches; the green parrot stands alone, eyes closed, wings folded on its chest, taking a slow deep breath, its crest flat and fully green again.

horizontal.caption: to calm a barking dog
horizontal.edit: Edit of the 6.5 s hug frame: a small dog stands in the green parrot's place, barking (mouth wide open, ears up); the blue parrot hugs it in the same pose and strokes its head with one wing. The green parrot is gone.

question: What is the blue parrot doing?
answerWhy: "It is hugging the angry parrot." was true but used only A-level words and missed the key word; the clip shows the hug calming the green parrot (crest fades from red to green), so "calming ... with a hug" is accurate and gives the B-level key verb.
notes: Original moved to the clip's frame at 6.5 s (carousel.originalS = 6.5): the blue parrot hugs the still-angry green parrot, the same frame the question uses; the 1.7 s still shows the moment BEFORE the calming. Tenses: past simple passive (castle era) / present continuous (original) / present perfect; carousel edits are edits of the 6.5 s frame, so the carousel needs that frame as its base image. Baby used per the owner correction of 5 Oct 2026: ordinary sleeping baby, safe living room. Voice gender for the parrots is arbitrary.
